theme_and_art_direction.vibe: Awwwards-level luxury hospitality. Calm, breathing space, tactile realism, and warm storytelling.
theme_and_art_direction.color_archetype: Organic & Earthy blended with Luxury (Deep Forest & Warm Sand)
theme_and_art_direction.mode: Light theme dominant with strategic Dark theme sections (for contrast in video or gallery areas).

typography.instructions: NEVER use default fonts. Include `<link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@300;400;600&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'>` in index.html.

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section breaks.
layouts_and_grids.hero: Full height (100vh) kinetic hero. Asymmetrical alignment. Huge serif typography intersecting with the background image. Overlay must be max bg-black/40.
layouts_and_grids.gallery: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-8. Span variations: col-span-8 row-span-2 (Hero image), col-span-4 (Supporting).

components.booking_bar: Sticky glassmorphism container (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/20 shadow-sm) at the bottom of the screen or bottom of hero. Contains DatePicker and 'Cek Ketersediaan' button.
components.calendar: Shadcn Calendar customized. Highlights today. Unavailable dates must be grayed out and disabled. Highlight selected range.
components.pricing_cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px delicate border (border-border). No heavy drop shadows. Generous internal padding (p-10). Use primary color for the CTA button ('Pesan via WhatsApp').
components.video_player: Large cinematic container. Minimal UI. Custom large play button overlay. Border radius max 8px.
components.marquee: The 'Editorial Ribbon'. Slow moving text showing amenities: 'Kamar Luas • WC Bersih • Dapur Besar • Wastafel Elegan'. Font-serif, pale background, dark earthy text.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular with 1px border. Hover effect: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and background color darken.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Framer Motion for page load (staggered text reveal on hero), scroll-triggered fade-up for sections, and parallax effect on hero image.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Image hover in gallery should have a subtle scale (scale-105) with long duration (duration-700).
motion_and_interactions.microinteractions: Buttons and interactive elements must have clear hover states with contrast shifts.

image_urls.description: Modern lodge nestled in a mountain forest landscape. Use for Hero background.
Rustic house in green trees. Use in Interactive Gallery.
Modern bedroom with large windows. Use for Facilities/Gallery.
Large kitchen with marble island. Use for Facilities/Gallery.
People swimming in natural pool. Use for Ambiance/Gallery.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over hero image has sufficient contrast (use bg-black/40 overlay).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NEVER use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
CREATE depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
DO NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Apply transitions to specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Use left alignment for text to maintain reading flow.
USE modern button styles with hover interaction animations. NO default browser styles.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, parallax, entrance).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., p-8 to p-24).
For the hybrid_fullstack setup: Create a simple backend (FastAPI) to manage booking dates. The frontend should fetch booked dates to disable them on the Shadcn Calendar.
The booking flow: User selects date -> Validates availability -> Fills form -> Redirects to WhatsApp API (`wa.me/6285395512330?text=...`) with formatted message.
